title: Oozy Creamy Tunisian Egg Wrap
description: A macrobiotic friendly Tunisian dish featuring a creamy egg filling wrapped in a crispy ssam wrap, perfect for adventurous eaters
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork until the whites and yolks are fully incorporated
Heat the olive oil in a non stick skillet over medium heat
Add the harissa to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly
Pour the whisked eggs into the skillet and scramble them until they are almost set
Stir in the labneh cheese and cook until the eggs are fully set and the cheese is melted
Season the egg mixture with salt and black pepper to taste
Warm the ssam wraps by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20 seconds
Assemble the wraps by spooning the egg mixture onto the center of each wrap and topping with chopped parsley
